text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The long expedition began, and serious 
training kicked off on French soil.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
“However, the Umamusume are rounding into 
peak form. There is no cause for concern—”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —I had it all wrong.

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text:
*wheeze*... *pant*...! *gasp*... 
*phew*...!

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: ...Guess that's it for today.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I rushed over to the Umamusume and tended 
to them. Their muscles were tighter than 
usual.
choice_data_list:
(Looks like it'll take a while to get 
"used to it.")

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even though I've grown used to the 
Longchamp track, the European training 
facilities are still largely uncharted 
territory for us.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Never mind the depth of the turf, the 
grounds themselves are massive. Just 
getting to the uphill, turf, or dirt 
course you want to practice on is an 
ordeal in itself.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The courses themselves are wide, making it 
difficult to simply reuse the previous 
training regimens that were centered 
around track practice.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Challenging Europe requires adapting to 
the environment right from the start of 
training.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...I wonder what would have happened if I 
had jumped in with zero know-how.

text_block_list.name: Internet Comments
text_block_list.text:
"Breaking: Project L'Arc Arrives on Site" 
"<chrname>'s name is trending on Umatta!"

text_block_list.name: Internet Comments
text_block_list.text:
"Did you see the morning show? Her 
interview was on!" "With how she looks 
this year, making the board will be a 
breeze!"

text_block_list.name: Shop Clerk
text_block_list.text:
The waiting line to purchase Arc de 
Triomphe cheer goods starts right over 
here!

text_block_list.name: Customer A
text_block_list.text:
Waah! Maybe I should buy it! Wouldn't this 
year's merch make a great souvenir!?

text_block_list.name: Customer B
text_block_list.text:
Right?! Japan's first-ever victory at the 
"Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe" is on the 
line, after all!!

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: ――...This year, I will win.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When I stepped into the hotel lobby where 
we were staying, Mei Satake had a grim 
expression on her face.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Ah, no, it's not that. Japan's 
atmosphere is as wonderful as ever.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Alright, tomorrow's schooling day. Let's 
get fired up and do this.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Schooling serves as a preliminary visit, 
providing an opportunity to experience the 
racecourse's waiting rooms, paddock, and 
track firsthand.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
However, normally, many teams do this at 
the time of final adjustments right before 
the actual event.
choice_data_list:
It's rare for you to finish this early, 
isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: Because that's my duty.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Let me do my absolute best. I've come this 
far, after all.

text_block_list.name: Letter
text_block_list.text: “Please, win.”

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: ...Everyone has high hopes for me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —And the next day.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
"In the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe, the 
pack tends to stay tightly bunched right 
up to the final straight. You shouldn't 
really count on the field stretching out."

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
"It's best to secure your position by the 
third corner. After that, it's a test of 
patience until you clear the false 
straight."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I seek guidance while standing on the real 
turf of ParisLongchamp Racecourse, not a 
VR simulation.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: <chrname> is calm as well, but—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even if she's used to seeing it in VR, 
it's the place of her dreams. She must be 
nervous.
choice_data_list:
It's earlier than planned, but shall we 
call it a day?

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: ...No, please continue.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: Even if it's slow. I'll make her run.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
If you're really that worried about 
running, I'll make arrangements for the 
gym right away.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
"...It's always been like this. If I don't 
push myself to the limit right now, I 
won't reach victory."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Tap-tap)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A tap on my shoulder made me turn around, 
and there stood <chrname>.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Grasped in that hand was the cooling spray 
she had received as part of the 
"Expedition Kit."
choice_data_list: Looks like <chrname> wants to keep going too.

It looks like <chrname> wants to keep going too, 
doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Without even needing to ask, her eyes were 
overflowing with determination.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even after the schooling session, <chrname> and the 
other selected representative Umamusume 
continued their training.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
There are less than two months left until 
the Prix Niel, her first true test of 
skill.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: —I'll build momentum right from my debut.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"We cannot afford to stop now. We are 
'Team Japan,' after all."
"Goal! I win~!"

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text:
"Kyahaha, Park-chan, you're too fast~!" 
"We should've given you a bigger 
handicap!" "Park-chan, piggyback~!"

"Fufu, sure! Now then, what game should we 
play next—"

text_block_list.name: Master
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, Venus Park. Didn't I tell you to 
rest after training?"

text_block_list.name: Venus Park
text_block_list.text: "Whoa, Master!? Um..."

text_block_list.name: Venus Park
text_block_list.text:
"...Because I'm full of energy! I've got 
so much power to spare, it's almost a 
problem!"

text_block_list.name: Venus Park
text_block_list.text:
"That's why I'm pushing myself to the 
limit in Master's place! It's my own 
personal training, training!"

text_block_list.name: Venus Park
text_block_list.text:
"Now then, who was the girl that wanted a 
piggyback ride from me?"

text_block_list.name: Master
text_block_list.text: "...Good grief, what a predicament."

text_block_list.name: Master
text_block_list.text:
"And to think I've put them through 
G1-level training..."

text_block_list.name: Master
text_block_list.text:
"...I feel sorry for whichever girl has to 
compete against you, Venus Park."
